affiliate.grain: one row per affiliate account per affiliate_oid

affiliate_click.grain: one row per affiliate click event per affiliate_click_oid

affiliate_ledger.grain: one row per affiliate commission ledger entry per affiliate_ledger_oid (one order item's commission for one affiliate at one tier)

analytics_session.grain: one analytics session row per client_session_oid

auto_order.grain: one row per auto-order (the subscription container; items live in auto_order_item)

auto_order_item.grain: one row per subscription item (uc_auto_orders × UNNEST(items)) — the recurring-revenue grain

conversation.grain: one row per conversation (chat/SMS thread) per conversation_uuid

customer_profile.grain: one row per registered customer profile (customer_profile_oid)

email_list_membership.grain: one row per current (list, marketing contact) membership

email_segment_membership.grain: one row per current (segment, marketing contact) membership

email_send.grain: one row per email/SMS send event to a marketing contact (per email_uuid)

gift_certificate.grain: one row per gift certificate account

inventory_snapshot.grain: one row per inventory movement event (with before/after levels)

marketing_contact.grain: one row per marketing-audience person (ESP customer profile, per esp_customer_uuid)

order.grain: one row per order (header grain; lines live in order_item)

order_item.grain: one row per order line (uc_orders × UNNEST(items))

payment_gateway.grain: one row per rotating transaction gateway configuration

pbx_call.grain: one row per PBX phone call per call_uuid

person_enrichment.grain: one row per enriched person per email_hash (TowerData third-party demographics)

screen_recording.grain: one current session/recording row per screen_recording_uuid

support_ticket.grain: one row per Zoho Desk helpdesk ticket per id

upsell_offer_event.grain: one upsell offer impression/outcome event per storefront_upsell_offer_event_oid

validation_limits: Historical dataset-specific metadata only; source capture time is unknown, legacy generation dates are retained as reported evidence.
Direct property types and referenced field existence/types are checked; derived SQL output types are declared, not inferred or dry-run verified.
No live freshness, permissions, tenant isolation, key uniqueness, join cardinality, identity coverage, PII safety or business-policy attestation.
Definition dependencies, output declarations and wildcard projections are checked; full SQL column/type semantics are not validated.
Ledger checks establish name coverage only, not exactly-once roles. Action guards are declarations, not runtime enforcement.
Deployable compilation is refused; offline previews carry unresolved scope/grain and are for local review only.
